title: chrysanthemum armenum
intro: Chrysanthemum armenum, commonly known as Armenian chrysanthemum, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, headache, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving circulation. The therapeutic actions of Armenian chrysanthemum include its sedative, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to calm the mind and body, reduce fever, and alleviate pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are used to develop herbal medicines and supplements.
